import type { TMessage, TOnMessage } from '../../../src'

import { useCallback, useRef, useState } from 'react'

import { Chat, Paper } from '../../../src'

const initialMessages: TMessage[] = [
    {
        id: '1',
        content: 'Здравствуйте! Чем могу помочь?',
        date: '2025-07-18T10:00:00Z',
        isUser: false,
        role: 'AI',
        isRead: true,
        senderId: 'ai-1',
        senderName: 'AI агент',
    },
    {
        id: '2',
        content: 'Подскажите, как оформить договор?',
        date: '2025-07-18T10:01:00Z',
        isUser: true,
        role: 'internal',
        isRead: true,
        senderId: 'user-1',
        senderName: 'Демидова Анна',
    },
]

const suggestions: string[] = ['Оформить договор', 'Посмотреть статус', 'Техническая поддержка']

export const ChatDemo = () => {
    const [messages, setMessages] = useState<TMessage[]>(initialMessages)
    const [isTypingAI, setIsTypingAI] = useState(false)
    const lastUserMessageIdRef = useRef<string | null>(null)

    const handleMessage: TOnMessage = useCallback((value, files) => {
        const userMessage: TMessage = {
            id: `${Date.now()}`,
            content: value,
            date: new Date().toISOString(),
            isUser: true,
            isRead: true,
            role: 'internal',
            senderId: 'user-1',
            senderName: 'Демидова Анна',
            attachedFiles: files,
            repliedMessage: undefined,
        }
        lastUserMessageIdRef.current = userMessage.id
        setMessages((prev) => [...prev, userMessage])

        // Имитация ответа AI
        setIsTypingAI(true)
        setTimeout(() => {
            setIsTypingAI(false)
            const aiMessage: TMessage = {
                id: `${Date.now() + 1}`,
                content: 'Спасибо за обращение! Я обработаю ваш запрос.',
                date: new Date().toISOString(),
                isUser: false,
                isRead: true,
                role: 'AI',
                senderId: 'ai-1',
                senderName: 'AI агент',
            }
            setMessages((prev) => [...prev, aiMessage])
        }, 1500)
    }, [])

    const chatProps = {
        attachVisible: true,
        footer: undefined,
        header: undefined,
        messages,
        onMessage: handleMessage,
        suggestions,
        title: 'AI помощник',
        typing: isTypingAI ? [{ role: 'AI' as const }] : undefined,
    }

    return (
        <Paper flexDirection="column" width="520px">
            <Chat {...chatProps} />
        </Paper>
    )
}

export const tableArgs: TSmartTableOptions<TDeliveryRegistry> = {
    columns: columnsDemo,
    meta: MDeliveryRegistry,
    enableOdataSearch: true,
    useInfinityQuery: useInfinityQueryMock,
}

export const SmartTableDemo = (tableArgs: TSmartTableOptions<TDeliveryRegistry>) => {
    const table = useSmartTable<TDeliveryRegistry>({
        manualFiltering: false,
        manualPagination: false,
        autoResetPageIndex: false,
        onPaginationChange: undefined,
        onEndReached: undefined,
        ...tableArgs,
    })

    return <Table table={table} />
}
